claims.claim: Customer and government concentration is a concrete execution-risk input rather than a generic quantum-industry concern: Infleqtion disclosed that two customers represented 60% and 12% of 2025 revenue, one customer represented 78% of year-end 2025 accounts receivable, and government customers represented 85% of Q1 2026 revenue.

Government concentration creates timing and contract-value sensitivity because government programs depend on appropriations and priorities and contracts can include termination-for-convenience or fixed-fee/cost allowability exposure; this should be treated as a source-addressed downside mechanism, not as evidence that a loss has occurred.

Capital-structure dilution remains measurable: immediately after the business combination Infleqtion had 216,471,927 common shares and 10,424,967 warrants outstanding, while its April 2026 resale/issuance prospectus covered up to 10,425,000 warrant-exercise shares and up to 121,829,432 shares offered by selling securityholders. These registrations are dilution/overhang inputs, not proof of future issuance or selling pressure.

A September 24, 2026 issuer filing reported achievement of 30 entangled logical qubits, reducing uncertainty around one previously forward technical milestone, but the same presentation characterizes commercialization, customer adoption, market opportunity and roadmap targets as forward-looking; technical milestone attainment therefore does not by itself close customer-economics or scalable-revenue risk.

risks.risk: Revenue and receivables concentration can amplify the effect of individual procurement delays, cancellations or budget changes.
Registered warrant shares and selling-securityholder shares create potential dilution/overhang pathways whose realized effect depends on exercises and actual sales.
Technical roadmap progress can precede economically scalable customer adoption.

contradictions.contradiction: The 30-entangled-logical-qubit milestone improves technical execution evidence while customer concentration, government dependence and scalable commercial economics remain separate unresolved dimensions.
contradictions.disposition: risk clarification; not a blocker by itself

unknowns.unknown: Current post-Q2 customer concentration and the share of 2026 revenue exposed to termination-for-convenience remain undisclosed in the evidence reviewed.
Actual future warrant exercises and selling-securityholder dispositions are unknown and should not be assumed.
